title: Minescape Addons
description: A hud to replicate the OSRS feel on the Minescape.com Server. Additions also include exp trackers
body:
![Main HUD](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/oVfeCX3m/images/ff2ed06c1f6079a5d78d7bdfcd665cde38c2032b.png)Add on mods to enhance the experience on the Minescape.com server. You get a working inventory with tabs for the main inventory, the quipment tab, stats tab and combat tab. Equipment tab has a functional stats screen to display armor stats. Items and skills have right click menu with clickable options. An xp/hr tracker that can be set to any skill to keep track of gains.
Xearos Minimap/World map come fully loaded with many icons indicating where things are on the server.

Mod List:
- Default Options
- Fancy Menu (Custom Main Menu)
- Iris (For Shaders)
- MinescapeAddons(Adds interactable osrs inventory, stats tracker, and more to the Minescape.com server)
- OpenLoader (loads default resource pack)
- Xaeros Minimap/World Map
 

Icons added to Xaeros Minimap by Zombie_Barrage with additions from LoreOSRS and MasterRiku
